title: FATCA/CRS controlling persons (KRA)
when: With a KRA upload file that has non-individual clients
purpose: The controlling persons of the non-individual clients in a KRA upload file, one line a person, with their role, tax residency and TINs.
linked: KYC & PMLA → FATCA / CRS: the controlling persons of a KRA file's clients.
source: No KRA format for controlling persons was found: KFintech KRA's circular KARVY/OPS/INTERM/GENRL/24-009 of 28 September 2024 says the process and data formats for non-individual clients will be notified separately. The data is what SEBI HO/38/14/(18)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25560/2026 of 11 November 2026, paras 6.1-6.3 (validity indicator, controlling persons, account type and pre-existing or new) asks for; the columns follow the client file's names where they can. To confirm with the KRA.
